description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionCreated class, an immutable event class representing the occurrence of a new connection being created within the system. It includes methods for creating instances from raw data or JSON, and is part of the connectivity events package in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a created connection event, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and handling connection details.
